title: Putting Right a Failure of the Chain's Own Handling on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan
content:
# Putting Right a Failure of the Chain's Own Handling on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

**Finance desk desk-book entry.** Where a priced charge stands on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan because of a failure of the chain's own handling, the desk gives money back on the plan under the service-recovery ground. The give-back goes on the plan's billing history as a negative entry against what is owed, tied to the priced charge it answers, dated and cycled on today's date and allocated to fees, so the customer sees the money come off the plan; because it is recorded under the service-recovery ground it does not consume the courtesy allowance the plan carries.

## Invoking `apply_service_recovery_giveback_b70a9c9e`

The agent unlocks `apply_service_recovery_giveback_b70a9c9e` and calls it. One call books a single give-back against one priced charge.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `financing_plan_id` | The reference number of the promotional financing plan record the give-back is booked to | An identifier, read from the financing plan lookup for this customer before the call |
| `source_entry_id` | The reference number of the priced charge entry the give-back answers | An identifier, read from the plan's billing history lookup, where priced charges carry the charge family and a positive amount |
| `giveback_amount` | The money given back to the plan | In USD as a positive number with 2 decimal places, half-up at the cent, with no currency symbol and no thousands separator; the entry itself is booked negative because it reduces what is owed |

**Return.** A single confirmation sentence in plain text naming the reference number minted for the new billing entry, the plan reference it was booked to, the charge entry it answers and the money given back in USD to two decimal places. That sentence naming the new entry reference is what indicates the give-back is on the plan's billing history.

## Points of judgement

- The call books the figure it is given; the figure itself is worked out from the plan's records and this desk's published rules before the call.
- The amount is passed as a positive figure even though the entry against what is owed is negative.
